title: sdr-daily-scratchpad-noah-wells-2026-03-05
content:
TODAY: 2026-03-05
Goal: 12 outbound touches, 4 meaningful conversations, 2 qualified leads.

MORNING BLOCK (9:00 - 11:30)
- Quick review: target list = mid-market SaaS + fintech expansion accounts. Prioritize Dedicated/Private fit (security/compliance asks).
- CRM triage: update status, log last activity for 10 accounts.

CALL LIST (priority order)
1) Helix Analytics — Pri: High
   - Contact: Maria Gonzalez, Head of ML Infra (maria.g@helixanalytics.com)
   - Notes: evaluating infra costs for LLM features, concerned about latency spikes when scaling.
   - Play: pitch Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity) + Optimize cost-savings (quantization/batching).
   - Last touch: Intro email 2026-03-02 (Avery). Next: call @ 10:15am, confirm agenda and decision criteria.

2) Northbridge Health — Pri: High
   - Contact: Daniel Park, CTO (daniel.park@northbridgehealth.io)
   - Notes: HIPAA questions, on-prem likely. Ask about audit/KMS needs.
   - Play: Private deployment + KMS/HSM integration, compliance pack.
   - Next: Send one-pager + NDA link by EOD. Template: /confluence/rdw-sales-playbook-2025 (see linked_artifacts).

3) EmberFin — Pri: Med
   - Contact: Priya Shah, Product Lead
   - Notes: prototyping chat assistant; cares about token pricing and throughput.
   - Play: Redwood API for fast PoC, offer trial credits and benchmark results.
   - Next: Follow-up email w/benchmarks + invite to demo (Jamie to co-host).

4) Atlas Commerce — Pri: Med
   - Contact: Tom Reed, Head of Platform
   - Notes: evaluating vector DB + embeddings. Could use Redwood for embeddings + reranking.
   - Next: schedule deep-dive next week.

FOLLOW-UPS (afternoon)
- Send tailored email to Northbridge w/ compliance checklist and draft NDA. Link to legal template: JIRA REDW-1123.
- Chase Helix for confirmation of 10:15 slot if no show by 10:05. If they push, offer recorded demo + perf slides.
- EmberFin: attach cost comparison sheet (internal template).

TALK TRACK SNIPPETS (copy-paste friendly)
- "We help engineering teams ship LLM features with predictable latency and unit economics — can I ask about your SLOs and current cost per 1M tokens?"
- "If security/compliance is key, we support Private deployments with KMS/HSM and audit logging — would a VPC or on-prem package be preferable?"
- "For PoCs, we provide trial credits and a short benchmark that shows latency and cost vs cloud defaults — 30 minute demo and a perf report afterwards.

TODO (quick)
- [ ] Upload Helix benchmark deck to share link
- [ ] Draft Northbridge NDA (use legal template)
- [ ] Update CRM with outcomes + next steps before EOD
- [ ] Log time spent per account for performance tracking (product ops ask)

UNRESOLVED QUESTIONS / NOTES TO SELF
- Need updated Dedicated pricing for 3-GPU reserved pool (Krista gave previous numbers but may be out of date). Ping @Krista.
- Check with engineering on latency SLO compliance for long context windows (REDW-1389 follow-up).
- Ask Solutions Eng to include KV-cache explanation in next demo: customers asking about warm-start speed.

RISK FLAGS
- Northbridge legal timeline could block Private deal (needs 3-week review). Consider fast-path NDA.
- Helix small PoC budget — propose 30-day trial with commit options.

END-OF-DAY REFLECTION
- Wins: got Helix on calendar (Tentative).
- Blockers: waiting on legal template from finance for Northbridge.

NOTES/RAW PASTE (for reuse)
- Email subject: "Quick question on your LLM infra costs + a possible low-risk PoC"
- LinkedIn message snippet: "Hi Maria — saw Helix's ML infra post, curious if you'd be open to a 15-min call on reducing per-token costs while improving latency?"

References: Confluence section: rdw-sales-playbook-2025, JIRA: REDW-1123, Slack notes in #bd-team thread 2026-03-01.
